svg.title: Three modes of a CSA2 layer
svg.desc: A CSA2 layer is Full, Reindex or Reuse. Full builds the compressed KV and the indexer keys and selects the top-k KV rows with its own indexer query. Reindex borrows the KV and indexer keys from the latest Full layer and reselects with its own indexer query. A Reuse layer has no indexer: it borrows the KV and the latest Full or Reindex selection. All three join the k selected rows with their own window KV and compute attention with their own query.

What a layer builds and what it borrows
